title: UN Commission finding on children killed on 7 October
summary: The Commission documented children among those killed during the 7 October attack in Israel.
claim: The Commission found that Palestinian armed groups killed children during their 7 October 2023 attack in Israel.
legal_characterization: Factual finding by a UN commission of inquiry; not a judicial judgment or assignment of individual criminal responsibility.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against the cited paragraphs of A/HRC/56/26 and the Commission methodology in paragraphs 3-7, including its reasonable-grounds standard. This is attributed to the Commission and is not a court judgment or an individual conviction. Classification judgment: the focused factual finding is categorized as children rather than attack-on-civilians; manual review is requested.
